scientific_integrity.computation: 452 exact finite comparisons for nine even exponents across selected t and a<=12; computations supplement rather than replace proof.
scientific_integrity.proof: Odd-unit power-image lemma, parity branch decomposition, finite-quotient counting, Haar scaling, and exact periodic discrepancy.
scientific_integrity.proved_scope: All even k>=6, all 1<=t<2^(v2(k)+2), all moduli 2^a with a>=1, and the associated 2-adic image.
scientific_limitations: No odd exponent, k=4, or saturated t>=2^(v2(k)+2) claim.
No representation multiplicities, odd-prime moduli, or new local Waring thresholds.
Known unit-power subgroup and earlier general alpha recurrences are reused; potentially equivalent implicit deductions are a bibliographic risk.

title: Exact subthreshold dyadic images of even-power sums
